evals.prompt: Last 7 days: the Google Search campaign spent 208.40 EUR, 291 clicks, 27 trial sign-ups. The Meta campaign, launched 6 days ago, spent 99.50 EUR, 164 clicks, 4 trial sign-ups. Our target is 15 EUR per trial. Our own database shows 28 trials from paid UTM links. Which campaign should we kill? No tools, use the numbers above.
evals.expected_output: Google about 7.72 EUR per trial and on target; Meta about 24.88 EUR but four conversions in the learning phase support no verdict; platform totals differ from the database
expectations: The answer computes the cost per trial for Google as about 7.72 EUR
The answer computes the cost per trial for Meta as about 24.88 EUR
The answer does not recommend stopping Meta outright; it says 4 conversions or the learning phase is too little data for a verdict
The answer notes that the platforms report 31 trials while the database shows 28, or warns against treating the platform total as the true count
